evidence.reason: Ordinary race in deploy ordering: deploy_plan snapshots `pre = preflight(...)` at line 1511, including the preservation digests, before `runner_units_stopped` and `drain_check` at 1514-1515. An in-flight tick can publish queue/heartbeat after that snapshot and exit, so drain succeeds; the helper then switches at 1525, and `preservation_check` at 1527 compares post-switch files against stale pre-drain digests, falsely reporting a preservation failure. The smallest fix is to capture the preservation baseline after the stopped-unit check and successful drain, while retaining the post-helper comparison. This is an implementation ordering bug, not a proposal to enlarge contract scope.
